issues.title: Core Mapping - show label next to MilSymbol
issues.body:
At some zoom levels users may wish to see the names/labels for the MilSymbol markers.

_Maybe_ we should provide a toggle button.

But, to start off with, we need to learn how to do this.  Investigate [MilSymbol](https://www.spatialillusions.com/milsymbol/) to find out how to provide a text label on the right-hand side. I'm pretty sure it fits into something called "additional text".

Once we've got that working, we can work on how/when to display it.
